house-round-back-low-walls.prompt: A round-log pen's low walls seen from behind: Astra's house-round-low-walls with the doorway in the left-front gable filled in with her own round, bark-on logs, each course continued from the plain logs beside it (her pixels moved along the logs' own slope), so the gable toward the viewer is blank logs and the door is in the far gable behind the walls; the window in the long side stays. interior-saddlebag.prompt: The rooms of a saddlebag house, cut away as Astra's interior-dog-run is and in exactly its camera and scale: two round-log pens wall to wall, a stone fireplace in the middle wall of each, their two stacks side by side over the middle as one double chimney, a window in each back wall, earth floors, no passage.
